before_admission: Bind exact source/code/version/recipe and identify estimator architecture, conditional sampling, joint/product distributions, adversarial signs and alternating schedules.

Declare feature site, native/probe measurement treatment, member-pair sampling or all-pair aggregation, score/loss scaling and competent predeclared hyperparameters; disclose graph-domain adaptations.
Audit autograd/detach boundaries so only permitted existing private factors receive model gradients; estimator parameters/optimizers may be separate but must be disclosed and charged.
Specify estimator updates and full auxiliary-state/moment/RNG rollback when a model proposal is rejected or scaled. Candidate transaction does not supply this control's missing policy.
Prepare source loss/sign, conditional sampling, estimator-gradient and source implementation replay witnesses; qualify a competent fixed recipe without this pilot's outcomes.
Charge estimator fits, adversarial updates, graphs/caches, extra memory, guards and rejected work. If qualification fails or recipe is unavailable, do not launch with a weak stand-in.

forde.source: arxiv:2306.02775v3, already-scoped sections 3.2, 3.4 and 3.5; custody reused through immutable proposal
before_admission: Bind exact published true-label score definition, normalization, kernel/repulsion, coefficient, graph adaptation and derivative sampling strategy. Do not silently choose raw logit, probability or log-probability.

Preserve explicit member and target axes and identify whether each target's derivative includes all original graph node features or a source-approved domain. Do not average member gradients before the diversity term.
For cached tokens T_k=P^k X, use differentiable construction or exact pullback grad_X=sum_k (P^k)^T grad_T_k; substitute actual native filter/normalization adjoints where needed.
Token-space gradient normalization/repulsion without pullback is a different coordinate-domain objective and cannot be labeled original-feature FoRDE.
If normalization/operators depend on original features, include their derivative too; a fixed-operator adjoint is insufficient in that case.
Keep create_graph/higher-order differentiation through frozen common/stem/classifier maps into private factors. Eval mode freezes statistics/dropout; it does not detach the forward.
Qualify original-X versus exact cached-adjoint equality, member-axis packing, true-label score and higher-order gradient custody, with predetermined precision tolerances and no pilot-outcome tuning.
Charge full-data derivative graph retention, higher-order backward work, complete graph/filter adjoints, memory, guards and rejected proposals. Unavailable or weak stand-in recipes prevent launch.
forde.prepared_adjoint_witness: prepared_witnesses.py demonstrates a fixed linear token pullback for an explicitly labeled synthetic true-label raw-logit graph fixture; it is not FoRDE source-recipe qualification.
